items.title: A permanent procedure based on HACCP principles is put in place, implemented and maintained
items.evidence_hint: HACCP plan or food safety management system manual; HACCP team and scope

items.title: Critical control points are identified for the hazards found and each has a critical limit
items.evidence_hint: HACCP plan: hazard analysis table, critical control points and their critical limits

items.title: Effective monitoring procedures are implemented at each critical control point
items.evidence_hint: HACCP plan monitoring section; temperature and cooking logs filled in at each critical control point

items.title: Corrective actions are set for when monitoring shows a critical control point is out of control
items.evidence_hint: HACCP plan corrective action section; corrective action entries in temperature or cooking logs

items.title: Procedures are carried out regularly to verify that the HACCP measures work effectively
items.evidence_hint: verification schedule; internal audit reports; thermometer calibration records; supervisor sign-off of logs

items.title: HACCP records commensurate with the business's nature and size show the measures are applied
items.evidence_hint: completed monitoring logs (temperature, cooling, cleaning, deliveries) kept with the HACCP plan

items.title: HACCP procedure documents are kept up to date and reviewed when a product or process changes
items.evidence_hint: HACCP plan revision history and version dates; review records after menu, supplier or equipment changes

items.title: Each establishment is notified to the competent authority for registration, and changes are notified
items.evidence_hint: notification for registration and the authority's acknowledgement or registration number; operating licence; notifications of changes in activity or closure

items.title: Food handlers are supervised and instructed or trained in food hygiene for their work activity
items.evidence_hint: training records and certificates; induction checklist; training plan; supervision or on-the-job instruction records

items.title: Staff who maintain the HACCP procedure or operate relevant guides have adequate HACCP training
items.evidence_hint: HACCP training certificates for the manager or HACCP team; training on the national good hygiene practice guide applied; training records

items.title: The operator establishes, maintains and can evidence an appropriate food safety culture
items.evidence_hint: food safety policy signed by management; roles and responsibilities chart; staff briefing or meeting minutes

items.title: Every person working in a food-handling area maintains a high degree of personal cleanliness
items.evidence_hint: personal hygiene policy or SOP (hand washing, nails, jewellery); hygiene audit or supervision checklists

items.title: All who work in food-handling areas wear suitable, clean and, where necessary, protective clothing
items.evidence_hint: dress code or uniform policy; protective clothing and laundry arrangements; hygiene audit checklists

items.title: Anyone ill with or carrying a foodborne disease is kept out of food areas if contamination is likely
items.evidence_hint: fitness-to-work or exclusion policy (diarrhoea, infected wounds, skin infections, sores, carriers); staff health declarations; exclusion and return-to-work records

items.title: Food handlers report illness or symptoms immediately to the food business operator
items.evidence_hint: illness reporting procedure; staff health declarations; illness or sickness reporting log

items.title: Hand washbasins have hot and cold running water, materials for cleaning hands and hygienic drying
items.evidence_hint: description of hand-washing stations in the good-practice manual; hygiene audit or maintenance records

items.title: The cold chain is unbroken except limited periods out of temperature control posing no health risk
items.evidence_hint: refrigerator and freezer temperature logs; goods-in temperature checks; HACCP critical limits for chilled storage and maximum time out of refrigeration during preparation and service

items.title: Foods held or served chilled are cooled as quickly as possible after cooking or final preparation
items.evidence_hint: cooling logs (time and temperature); blast chiller records; HACCP cooling procedure

items.title: Foods are thawed so as to minimise pathogen growth, with risky run-off liquid drained
items.evidence_hint: thawing procedure or SOP; thawing logs; thawing step in the HACCP plan

items.title: Cold storage lets temperatures be monitored and, where necessary, recorded, and has enough capacity
items.evidence_hint: equipment list with fridge and freezer thermometers or probes; temperature logs; refrigeration maintenance records

items.title: Equipment used for a listed allergen is cleaned and checked before use for food free of it
items.evidence_hint: allergen management procedure covering the allergens in Annex II to Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011; allergen matrix; cleaning and visible-debris check records for shared equipment

items.title: Food is protected against contamination at all stages of production, processing and distribution
items.evidence_hint: food handling SOPs (covering, labelling, storage order, colour-coded boards); hygiene audit reports

items.title: Raw materials contaminated beyond what normal sorting or preparation can make fit are not accepted
items.evidence_hint: goods-in or delivery records with acceptance and rejection checks; approved supplier list; supplier specifications

items.title: Rooms allow raw materials to be stored apart from processed food, with enough separate cold storage
items.evidence_hint: storage plan or SOP separating raw and ready-to-eat food; fridge layout; HACCP plan

items.title: Raw materials and ingredients are stored to prevent harmful deterioration and contamination
items.evidence_hint: storage SOP (covered, labelled, off the floor, first in first out); stock rotation records; dry store checks

items.title: Hazardous and inedible substances are labelled and stored in separate, secure containers
items.evidence_hint: chemical inventory and safety data sheets; chemical storage procedure; labelling of decanted products

items.title: Food premises are kept clean and maintained in good repair and condition
items.evidence_hint: cleaning schedule and signed cleaning records; maintenance log; hygiene audit reports

items.title: Food-contact items are cleaned and, where necessary, disinfected often enough to avoid contamination
items.evidence_hint: cleaning and disinfection plan with frequencies for food-contact equipment; signed cleaning records

items.title: Cleaning agents and disinfectants are not stored in areas where food is handled
items.evidence_hint: chemical storage procedure; cleaning plan stating where products are kept; premises layout

items.title: Adequate procedures are in place to control pests
items.evidence_hint: pest control contract; pest control visit reports; bait station map; pest sighting log

items.title: Domestic animals are kept from food areas or, where the authority allows it, from contaminating food
items.evidence_hint: hygiene policy or good-practice manual rule on animals; any permission from the competent authority and its conditions; hygiene audit reports

items.title: Openable windows in food rooms have removable insect-proof screens where necessary
items.evidence_hint: pest control reports (proofing recommendations); maintenance records; premises description

items.title: An adequate supply of potable water is used wherever needed to keep food from contamination
items.evidence_hint: water analysis reports; public water supply contract or bill; water tank cleaning records

items.title: Ice that touches or may contaminate food is made from potable water (or clean water for whole fish)
items.evidence_hint: ice machine cleaning and descaling records; water analysis reports; cleaning plan

items.title: Ventilation is adequate and its filters and parts are accessible for cleaning or replacement
items.evidence_hint: extraction hood and filter cleaning records; ventilation maintenance contract or service reports

items.title: Floors and walls in food rooms are sound and easy to clean and, where necessary, to disinfect
items.evidence_hint: maintenance log; hygiene audit or inspection reports; premises description

items.title: Equipment in contact with food is kept in good order, repair and condition
items.evidence_hint: equipment maintenance log; repair records; hygiene audit reports

items.title: Food waste goes in closable containers unless other containers or systems are shown to be suitable
items.evidence_hint: waste management procedure (lidded bins or a food waste disposal unit); bin cleaning in the cleaning plan; hygiene audit reports

items.title: Refuse stores are managed so they can be kept clean and, where necessary, free of animals and pests
items.evidence_hint: waste area cleaning records; pest control reports covering the refuse area

items.title: Waste is disposed of hygienically and does not become a source of contamination
items.evidence_hint: waste collection contract; used cooking oil collection certificates; waste transfer records
